info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Bournon Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Bournon Notebook Detail Management API enables users to efficiently create detailed entries for Bournon notebooks within the catalog. This API streamlines the process of adding specifications, features, and other relevant information about Bournon notebooks. Typical consumers include catalog managers and e-commerce platforms seeking to enhance their product offerings. The API allows for seamless integration of notebook details into existing systems, promoting better organization and accessibility of product information.

post.summary: Create details for a Bournon notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and add specific details to a Bournon notebook. You will need to provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully create the notebook details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Bournon notebook. It must include the necessary fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the notebook details are returned.
